<!-- All news items below this line -->

;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Gulf of Oman incident]], [[Iran–United States relations]], [[United Arab Emirates - Iran relations]]
**The [[United States Maritime Administration]] (MARAD) issues a new alert to all ships passing [[Fujairah]], off the coast of the [[United Arab Emirates]] on the [[Gulf of Oman]] over "acts of sabotage" amid heightened regional tensions between the [[United States]] and [[Iran]]. [https://www.apnews.com/b571ec62b9f64e65ad33eda04e390aa9 (Associated Press)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Four people are killed when two [[floatplane|sightseeing planes]], with a total of 14 [[Princess Cruises|Royal Princess]] ship tourists, collide near  [[Ketchikan, Alaska]]. Multiple people were rescued though two others are missing. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/alaska-plane-crash-2-sightseeing-planes-carrying-cruise-ship-tourists-collide-midair-near-ketchikan-alaska-2019-05-14/ (CBS News)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/14/us/ketchikan-plane-crash-alaska.html (''The New York Times'')]

;International relations
*[[Iran–United Kingdom relations]]
**An Iranian woman is sentenced to 10 years in prison for suspected spying for the [[United Kingdom]]. A judiciary spokesman alleged that she was recruited by the [[British Council|British Council's]] [[Iran]] desk. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-uk-spy/iran-says-it-has-sentenced-iranian-woman-to-10-years-for-spying-for-uk-idUSKCN1SJ0NH (Reuters)]
*[[China–United States trade war]], [[China–United States relations]]
**[[China]] announces its intent to increase tariffs from 10% to 25% on $60 billion worth of imports from the [[United States]] effective June 1, 2019. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/05/13/china-is-raising-tariffs-on-60-billion-of-us-goods-starting-june-1.html (CNBC)]
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]], [[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**[[Venezuela]]n [[National Assembly (Venezuela)|National Assembly]] leader [[Juan Guaidó]] formally requests help from the [[United States Southern Command]] (SOUTHCOM) for "strategic and operational planning" against the government of [[Nicolás Maduro]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/may/13/venezuela-news-latest-guaido-us-military-help-maduro (''The Guardian'')]

;Law and crime
*Prosecutors in [[Sweden]] reopen the rape allegation investigation against [[WikiLeaks]] founder [[Julian Assange]]. Swedish prosecutors mention their intent to seek extradition of Assange from the [[United Kingdom]] after he has served his 50-week prison sentence for skipping bail. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48253343 (BBC News)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/13/world/europe/assange-sweden-investigation.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.apnews.com/a3053bfbb08b45f68bdd22fbc2404a8f (Associated Press)]
*A 36-year-old man is arrested just outside [[Casa Rosada]] in [[Argentina]], armed with a handgun, after requesting to hold an interview with [[President of Argentina|President]] [[Mauricio Macri]]. [https://www.perfil.com/noticias/policia/casa-rosada-detuvieron-hombre-armado-que-queria-ver-presidente-mauricio-macri%20.phtml (''Perfil'')] 
*[[2019 college admissions bribery scandal]]
**Actress [[Felicity Huffman]] pleads guilty to conspiracy to commit [[Mail and wire fraud|mail fraud]] and honest services mail fraud and admits to paying $15,000 for a proctor to change her daughter's [[SAT]] answers. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/felicity-huffman-pleads-guilty-college-admissions-scandal-n1005056 (NBC News)]
*[[Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections]]
**Trump's [[United States Attorney General|U.S. Attorney General]] [[William Barr]] appoints Republican [[United States Attorney|U.S. Attorney]] for the [[United States District Court for the District of Connecticut|District of Connecticut]] [[John Durham (lawyer)|John Durham]] to investigate the origins of the [[Crossfire Hurricane (FBI investigation)|Crossfire Hurricane]] and [[Mueller special counsel investigation|Special Counsel investigations]], and any criminality that may have occurred. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/u-s-attorney-to-review-russia-probe/ (CBS News)] [https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/13/politics/john-durham-russia-probe/ (CNN)]
*The [[Supreme Court of the United States]] (SCOTUS) rules in ''[[Franchise Tax Board of California v. Hyatt (2019)|Franchise Tax Board of California v. Hyatt]]'', that a state [[Law of the United States|cannot be sued]] in another state's court, overturning a {{nowrap|40-year-old}} precedent. The 5-4 decision overrules the ''{{nowrap|Nevada v. Hall}}'' ''[[Precedent|stare decisis]]'' set in 1979 which allowed private suits from one state to be brought in another state's court. [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/nation/supreme-court-rules-a-state-cant-be-sued-in-another-states-courts (PBS)] [https://www.scotusblog.com/case-files/cases/franchise-tax-board-of-california-v-hyatt-2/ (SCOTUS Blog)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Philippine general election]]
**Voters in the [[Philippines]] go to the polls to elect new members of the [[Senate of the Philippines]] and [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]], as well as various other local positions. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/12/world/asia/philippines-election-senate-duterte.html (''The New York Times'')] 
*[[2019 Guatemalan general election]]
**The [[Constitutional Court of Guatemala|Constitutional Court]] determines that [[Zury Ríos]] has a constitutional impediment to be a presidential candidate and leaves her out of the electoral contest. Her constitutional impediment is for being the daughter of former dictator [[Efraín Ríos Montt]]. [https://www.prensalibre.com/guatemala/politica/zury-rios-queda-fuera-de-la-contienda/ (''Prensa Libre'')]

;Science and technology
*[[United States|American]] undersea explorer [[Victor Vescovo]] sets a new world record for the deepest ever sea dive at {{convert|10,972|m}} in the [[Pacific Ocean]]'s [[Mariana Trench]]. Several unusual things are discovered at the bottom, including four new species of prawn-like [[crustaceans]], a new species of [[snailfish]], strange brightly coloured rocky outcrops and a [[plastic bag]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-48230157 (BBC News)]
